title: GAP DISCOVERY ANALYST — CTO Directive Step 4: per-fabric V1 provision verdicts, structurally-necessary gaps, loop-closure critical path, and explicit inflation rejections
authority: CTO directive: structurally-necessary-for-V1 capabilities belong in V1 even if undocumented/implied/absent from the original architecture (required by another V1 capability or by security, reliability, verification, or actual runtime operation); only V1/V2 buckets exist; do not inflate

Completeness loop: Reality -> Observation -> Representation -> Context -> Intelligence -> Decision -> Mission -> Delegation -> Worker Execution -> Action -> State Change -> Evidence -> Verification -> Outcome -> Memory -> Observation
inputsReused: architecture/coregrid-mvp-architecture/reconstruction/STREAM_H_IMPLEMENTATION_MAP.json (17 capability families, 8 orphans, verify baseline 3458 unit tests PASS)
method: READ-ONLY over all same-session stream artifacts, registry, proofs, and the implementation tree. For each of the 16 CTO fabrics: (a) provision verdict from implementation evidence (STREAM H verified/orphan/unverified) and corpus evidence (E/F/G/I); (b) gaps only where a capability is structurally necessary for loop closure or for a legitimate production platform (security, failure, tenancy, cost, operational dimensions), each with evidence, an owner drawn from F's V1 bucket or an explicit new-artifact proposal, and a deliverable kind; (c) inflation rejections recorded explicitly. A gap exists only if NO verified V1 owner already covers it; gaps that restate an already-tracked stream finding reference that finding rather than duplicating it.
